user.title: Thermal Balance Setup
user.description: Configure room parameters and select input sensors.

data_description.room_area: Floor area of the room in m²
data_description.ceiling_height: Height of the ceiling in meters
data_description.window_area: Total glazing area facing outside in m²
data_description.external_walls_fraction: How many walls face outside (0.25 = 1 of 4, 0.50 = 2 of 4, etc.)
data_description.ac_max_cooling: Maximum cooling output of your AC unit in Watts (from spec sheet)
data_description.ac_airflow: Airflow volume of the indoor AC unit in m³/h (from spec sheet)
data_description.u_wall: Wall thermal transmittance W/(m²·K) — lower = better insulated
data_description.u_window: Window thermal transmittance W/(m²·K) — lower = better insulated
data_description.use_empirical_hlc: Enable to automatically use real-world measured room K-factor heat loss instead of theoretical estimates.
data_description.sensor_t_in: Sensor providing indoor air temperature in °C
data_description.sensor_t_out: Sensor providing outdoor air temperature in °C
data_description.sensor_t_ac_exit: Sensor or input_number with measured air temperature at AC louver outlet in °C (optional)
data_description.sensor_rh_in: Sensor providing indoor relative humidity in % (optional)
data_description.sensor_rh_out: Sensor providing outdoor relative humidity in % (optional)
data_description.sensor_solar: Sensor providing solar irradiance in W/m²
data_description.sensor_illuminance: Indoor illuminance lux sensor used to auto-detect curtain shading (optional)
data_description.illuminance_threshold: Lux threshold below which curtains are considered closed (default 150 lx)
data_description.sensor_ac_power: Sensor providing real-time AC electrical power consumption in W
data_description.sensor_window: Binary sensor indicating window open/closed state (optional)
data_description.sensor_wind_speed: Sensor providing wind speed in m/s or km/h (optional)
data_description.sensor_wind_direction: Sensor providing wind direction in degrees 0-360 (optional)
data_description.window_azimuth: Azimuth angle the window faces to calculate direct wind impact (0=N, 90=E, 180=S, 270=W)

error.invalid_sensor: Selected entity is invalid or does not exist.
